verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's signature layering, with the headline sitting on the red T bar and the copy over the stem. But 'NOW!' wraps onto its own orphan line, the whole group is shrunk into the centre with big empty blue areas on the left and right, and copy runs over the red/blue edge of the stem. B pulls the T away and parks it on the right as a separate block, so 'JOIN VOLUNTEERING NOW!' loses its red highlight and the copy becomes a flat white list on plain blue that barely looks like the same design; the text sits too far right with a large empty left margin, and the T reads as random decoration.
